explanation: Only the month that starts on or after 1 January 2026 is turned into a missing value: January 2026 has not ended by the as-of date, so its count is not known. December 2025 has ended, so its 0 is a real 0: no account was active. Showing the January cell as 0 would read as if every account had left, and showing December as missing would hide a real drop.
